# unifi_protect_viewer (Resource)

A UniFi Protect Viewer (UP-Viewport), identified by MAC. Configures the existing, adopted device over the private Protect API (`/proxy/protect/api/viewers/<id>`): name and the live view pushed to its display. `terraform destroy` removes the viewer from state and leaves it configured; set `forget_on_destroy = true` to unadopt it. **Config writes are HIL-unverified — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) Viewer MAC address (the natural key); any separator/case is accepted and normalized. The device must be adopted. Immutable — changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `forget_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, `terraform destroy` unadopts (forgets) the viewer instead of just removing it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `liveview` (String) Object id of the `unifi_protect_liveview` pushed to this viewer's display.
- `name` (String) Viewer display name.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Current management IP/host.
- `id` (String) Protect object id (24-hex). Import key.
- `is_adopted` (Boolean) Whether the viewer is adopted by this console.
- `model` (String) Hardware model.
- `state` (String) Connection state.
- `stream_limit` (Number) Maximum number of parallel live streams the viewer supports.
